explanation: The text omits the label's qualifier that inavolisib+fulvestrant is indicated only 'following recurrence on or after completing adjuvant endocrine therapy,' not simply for any PIK3CA-mutated, endocrine-resistant patient.
suggested_rewrite: Specify: inavolisib plus fulvestrant is indicated for PIK3CA-mutated, endocrine-resistant HR+/HER2- disease following recurrence on or after completing adjuvant endocrine therapy.
